_README: This file lives in your credit-catalyst project. Update it whenever you add a capability. The pitch deck reads from this file so it always reflects what the system actually does.
_HOW_TO_REGENERATE_DECK: Copy this file next to deck.js, then run: node deck.js

system_status.ai_engine: Claude API for filing analysis + documentation scrubbing

live.name: SEC Filing Monitor
live.description: Scans SEC EDGAR every 1-10 minutes for 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K filings from iTraxx watchlist companies
live.detail: Covers 14 US-listed companies from the 200-name universe. Auto-restarts on reboot.

live.name: European Filing Monitor
live.description: Monitors Companies House (UK), Investegate RNS (UK), EQS News/DGAP (Germany), and AMF (France) for regulatory filings
live.detail: Covers 13 UK companies via Companies House API + scrapes Investegate and EQS. Each filing classified for credit impact via Claude API. AMF source added for French disclosures.

live.name: AI Filing Analysis
live.description: Claude API summarises each filing and flags credit-relevant language, covenant triggers, and management red flags
live.detail: Scores severity 1-5, classifies impact (positive/negative/neutral), and extracts key credit phrases

live.name: Telegram Alerts
live.description: Real-time alerts sent to phone for SEC filings, European filings, equity movers, and social sentiment signals
live.detail: Severity-based filtering — only material alerts (severity >= 2) trigger notifications

live.name: Company Watchlist Database
live.description: 200 companies tracked with CDS spreads, credit rating, sector, and priority scoring
live.detail: Covers full iTraxx Main (125) and Crossover (75) indices with entity profiles

live.name: CDS Pricer
live.description: CDS pricing with spread interpolation, risky annuity, and upfront/running conversion
live.detail: HY convention (500bp running), IG convention (100bp running). Used across scenario analysis and trade structuring.

live.name: Tranche Pricer & Scenario Engine
live.description: Index tranche pricing with constituent-level risk decomposition and scenario stress testing
live.detail: Full reprice P&L with convexity across 8 macro scenarios. Per-name CS01_i, JTD, and correlation (rho01) sensitivities.

live.name: 8 Macro Scenario Stress Tester
live.description: Non-uniform spread shocks by rating, sector, and name across ECB cuts/hikes, recession, China crisis, sovereign stress, LME wave, fallen angel cascade, and risk-on squeeze
live.detail: Exact re-pricing (not DV01 approximation). Sector heatmap, direction breakdown, hedge effectiveness.

live.name: Portfolio Risk Manager
live.description: Aggregate Greeks (CS01, rho01, theta), JTD, parametric VaR, and risk limit traffic light system
live.detail: $250m AUM. Stop-loss cascade: 1% daily, 2% weekly, 3.5% monthly, 5% max P2T. 5% single-name concentration hard limit. 90% liquidatable in 5 days.

live.name: Relative Value Engine
live.description: Rich/cheap screening across CDS, bonds, and tranches with sector z-scores and basis tracking
live.detail: Composite scores from spread level, momentum, sector RV, and documentation risk

live.name: Credit-Equity Bridge
live.description: Gap score engine — credit signal strength minus equity repricing score identifies mispriced equity options
live.detail: 7 credit dimensions, 4 equity dimensions. Trade structurer decision tree recommends optimal instrument.

live.name: Social Sentiment Monitor
live.description: Multi-source social data from Bittensor subnets (SN13, SN22, SN42) for early warning signals
live.detail: Wired into equity movers scan pipeline with Telegram alerts

live.name: Covenant Risk Tracker
live.description: Covenant headroom monitoring across iTraxx universe with restricted payment baskets and portability analysis
live.detail: Profiles stored per entity with breach alerts

live.name: Maturity Wall Analyser
live.description: Refinancing risk analysis — upcoming maturities cross-referenced with leverage and market conditions
live.detail: Identifies names with near-term maturity walls at stressed spread levels

live.name: Streamlit Dashboard
live.description: Interactive dashboard with tranche scenarios, single-name blowout stress, sector heatmaps, and spread distribution
live.detail: Live data from API endpoints. Includes CS01 from/to on blowout scenarios.

in_progress.name: Documentation Analysis Engine
in_progress.description: AI-powered deep scrubbing of credit agreements, indentures, and restricted payment baskets across 200 names
in_progress.status: building — covenant profiles exist, full doc parsing in progress

in_progress.name: Liquidity Regime Dashboard
in_progress.description: Howell-inspired global liquidity framework for regime-based position sizing

future.name: IBKR API Integration
future.description: Automated trade execution via Interactive Brokers
future.status: account exists, API connection built, needs live testing

architecture.current: Multi-agent system with 24 monitors, 34 analytics modules, FastAPI + Streamlit dashboards, VPS deployment
architecture.target: Full autonomous monitoring + structured trade recommendations

agents.name: Analyst (The Watcher)
agents.role: Monitors filings, ratings, spreads — generates signals

agents.name: Strategist
agents.role: Evaluates signals, cross-references with docs and regime, sizes positions

agents.name: Briefer
agents.role: Produces daily briefing with actionable trade ideas and key insights

agents.name: Risk Manager
agents.role: Pre-trade risk limits, portfolio stress tests, stop-loss monitoring

daily_stop_loss.action: Flatten all positions; review before resuming

monthly_drawdown.action: Reduce to 25% risk; CIO approval to rebuild

max_peak_to_trough.action: Full de-risk; strategy review with risk committee

liquidity_test.action: Ongoing monitoring — portfolio must be liquidatable
